overview.description: The Invesco MSCI USA ETF (PBUS) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the MSCI USA index. The fund tracks a market-cap-selected and -weighted index of mid and large-cap US stocks. PBUS was launched on Sep 22, 2017 and is issued by Invesco.

data.title: 3 Great ETFs That Hold SpaceX
data.text: Hundreds of ETFs now hold SpaceX, but few own much.

holdings.infoBox: PBUS is an equity ETF with a total of 517 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 7.92%, Apple at 7.48%, Microsoft at 5.51%, Alphabet at 5.47%, and Amazon.com at 3.68%.
